note: ~250,000 ha wooded at the end of the 18th century, mostly coastal and riverside woods
Core forest + ~70,000 ha of dunes sown + ~20,000 ha drained and sown under Chambrelent by 1855
Planted pine area roughly doubles within ~30 years of the 1857 law
Resin industry boom; moors largely planted
Massif close to one million hectares before the war
Fires of the 1940s burn ~40% of the massif (~400,000 ha); 1949 alone 131,300 ha, incl. ~50,000 ha around Cestas and Saucats
Replanting in rows with firebreaks; first large farm clearings
Maize clearings of the 1960s-70s; forest cover stable since 1979
Storm Martin (27 Dec 1999): more than 120,000 ha strongly affected, ~27 million m3 down
Storm Klaus (24 Jan 2009): ~300,000 ha damaged, ~40 million m3 down
Landiras and La Teste-de-Buch fires: ~30,000 ha
IFN: 987,950 ha of forest (74.3% cover). Burned: Saumos ~42,000 ha and Biscarrosse ~3,600 ha in July 2026, plus 2022 burns still regrowing
